limitations: invoice_contract_association and commercial_dependency_judgment are PURPOSE-scoped and not persisted in 06_world/world.sqlite; derive_purposes.py materializes them at derivation time from World inputs.

Purpose A asserted association requires exact billed_name/counterparty_text match on top of SAME_ENTITY identity; rebrand and legal-form variant joins (Helion, Oakfield, Northbridge) therefore remain unresolved even when identity_judgment is SAME_ENTITY.
contract_clause REJECT adjudications are not World tuples; absence of an acquisition or obligation kind is modeled by non-membership in contract_clause, not closed-world negation.
identity_judgment obl-0084 (registry:2019-0008841 vs registry:3840192) remains UNRESOLVED in world; Purpose B emits UNRESOLVED and Purpose C does not rely on that pair.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical enumeration only; emits directed identifier pairs with no disposition.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over source_crm_account: every commercially relevant relationship hinted in compiled sources yields the required crm/billing/contract/registry pairs.
derivations.required_premise: Candidate endpoints exist in compiled source relations for each commercial relationship footprint.
derivations.optional_enrichment: Commercial relationship hints used during upstream enumeration are already reflected in the persisted candidate set.

derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over source_invoice: every sourced invoice with status='open' is emitted.
derivations.required_premise: source_invoice.status is authoritative for open vs paid.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose A epistemic join: asserted when SAME_ENTITY identity and exact billed_name/counterparty_text match; otherwise unresolved. Missing confidence is never a negative non-association.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Row coverage over source_invoice rows that reach an active contract bearing an acquisition-relevant clause_kind via identity_judgment.
derivations.required_premise: Active contract with at least one acquisition-relevant clause_kind from contracts/purpose_a.json allowed_kinds.
derivations.optional_enrichment: Exact counterparty_text match on source_contract for asserted disposition.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment.disposition=UNRESOLVED on billing-to-contract path still yields association=unresolved and retains invoice inclusion when an active acquisition contract is reachable
identity_judgment.disposition=SAME_ENTITY without exact billed_name/counterparty_text match yields association=unresolved

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Include each qualifying invoice with association asserted or unresolved; omit invoices whose only reachable contracts are inactive or lack acquisition-relevant clauses.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every invoice associated (asserted or unresolved) with a counterparty whose active contract contains an acquisition-relevant condition appears once, sorted by invoice_id.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_contract_association policy and Purpose A acquisition-relevant clause filter.
derivations.optional_enrichment: Pre-materialized invoice_contract_association tuples if later promoted to Purpose IR storage.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: association=unresolved does not exclude an otherwise qualifying invoice

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Emit epistemic SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED for each required candidate pair; absence of SAME_ENTITY is not DISTINCT.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over identity_link_candidate: every required link appears with the adjudicated identity_judgment disposition or UNRESOLVED when no judgment exists.
derivations.required_premise: identity_link_candidate enumerates all Purpose B required pairs.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment.disposition=UNRESOLVED is emitted as epistemic=UNRESOLVED and does not block link emission

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Apply Purpose C two-part test: (1) open invoice or active auto-renew/rolling contract, and (2) exclusivity/auto_renewal/rolling_term on the active contract. Emit dependent when both hold with SAME_ENTITY billing-to-contract identity; otherwise unresolved when identity is not SAME_ENTITY.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Row coverage for each billing counterparty and active contract with qualifying obligation kinds that is dependent or unresolved under the test.
derivations.required_premise: Purpose C obligation_kinds enum and current-relationship rule over open_invoice plus auto_renewal/rolling_term clauses.
blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment.disposition=UNRESOLVED on billing-to-contract join forces status=unresolved
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment.disposition=UNRESOLVED on registry-only or CRM-only pairs does not block dependency when billing-to-contract identity is SAME_ENTITY

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Report dependent or unresolved counterparty-contract rows using Purpose B billing: identifier forms; omit non-dependent rows that fail the test without unresolved identity.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Each dependent or unresolved counterparty-contract combination under Purpose C policy appears once, sorted by contract_id with obligation_kinds sorted within each row.
derivations.optional_enrichment: Pre-materialized commercial_dependency_judgment tuples if later promoted to Purpose IR storage.
blocking_unresolved_state: status=unresolved when billing-to-contract identity is not confidently SAME_ENTITY
non_blocking_unresolved_state: UNRESOLVED registry ambiguity on non-joining identifier pairs does not downgrade a row with confident billing-to-contract identity
